content.text: The Top 7 Options for Selling Digital Products from Africa

1. NOWPayments - Offers 300+ cryptocurrencies, 0.5% fee, no KYC requirements, and automatic webhook verification of on-chain payments. It supports countries with restricted payment gateways like Nigeria and Pakistan. Deploy NOWPayments with Cloudflare Pages and GitHub for a seamless digital commerce experience. 2. Binance P2P - Supports naira, cedis, Kenyan shillings, and Pakistani rupees, making it an excellent choice for local transactions. It also offers USDT on Tron, settling in under 60 seconds for a fee under $0.10. 3. Supabase - A cloud-based database that provides a scalable and secure storage solution for digital products. It integrates seamlessly with Cloudflare Workers for a robust backend logic. 4. Google Drive - Offers secure file storage and delivery for digital products. It integrates with Cloudflare R2 for large file transfers. 5. Cloudflare Workers - A serverless platform for executing backend logic, perfect for automating tasks like payment processing and digital product delivery. 6. GitHub Pages - A free hosting solution for static websites that can be easily integrated with NOWPayments and Cloudflare Workers. 7. Edge Commerce Stack - A sovereign digital commerce stack developed by COREMERCH, featuring a complete combination of free and paid tools for building, deploying, and scaling online stores. It includes automatic crypto payment processing, instant product delivery, and full data ownership.
Why Each Item on This List Matters

Each item on this list is essential for creating a seamless digital commerce experience in Africa. NOWPayments provides a secure and efficient payment processing system, while Binance P2P offers a local transaction solution. Supabase and Cloudflare Workers ensure a scalable and secure backend logic, while Google Drive and GitHub Pages provide secure file storage and hosting. The Edge Commerce Stack offers a comprehensive solution for building, deploying, and scaling online stores.
The Ones Most Creators Get Wrong

Many creators get wrong by choosing payment gateways that are not available in their region, resulting in restricted access to international buyers. They also fail to consider the importance of secure file storage and delivery, leading to lost sales and customer frustration. By prioritizing the options on this list, creators can avoid these common mistakes and create a successful digital commerce experience.
Blockchain-based payments can bypass geographical barriers and limitations, making it possible to reach international buyers in Africa.
How to Prioritise What to Implement First

To prioritize what to implement first, identify your primary goals and focus on the options that align with them. If you're looking to process payments efficiently, start with NOWPayments. If you need a local transaction solution, use Binance P2P. For a scalable and secure backend logic, choose Supabase and Cloudflare Workers. By prioritizing your goals, you can create a digital commerce experience that meets your needs and exceeds customer expectations.
Putting the List Into a Deployable Stack

To put this list into a deployable stack, start by deploying GitHub Pages and Cloudflare Workers. Then, integrate NOWPayments and Binance P2P for payment processing and local transactions. Finally, add Supabase and Google Drive for secure backend logic and file storage.
